from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


class TestSyntaxErrors:
    """Test that invalid duration strings raise ValueError."""

    def test_missing_p_marker(self):
        """P marker is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "1Y")

    def test_just_p(self):
        """P alone is invalid; at least one component required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P")

    def test_p_with_just_t(self):
        """T without any time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT")

    def test_t_without_time_component(self):
        """T must be followed by at least one time component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1DT")

    def test_whitespace_in_duration(self):
        """No whitespace allowed anywhere."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P 1D")

    def test_lowercase_p(self):
        """P and designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "p1D")

    def test_lowercase_designators(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1d")

    def test_sign_on_component(self):
        """Sign on individual component is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P-1D")

    def test_component_out_of_order_ym(self):
        """Components must be in order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M1Y")

    def test_component_out_of_order_dw(self):
        """Days before weeks violates order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1D1W")

    def test_component_out_of_order_hd(self):
        """Time components before T is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1H1D")

    def test_duplicate_year(self):
        """Each component appears at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month(self):
        """Each component appears at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_time_component(self):
        """Each component appears at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1H2H")

    def test_weeks_with_days(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W3D")

    def test_weeks_with_time(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2WT1H")

    def test_weeks_with_months(self):
        """W cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2W")

    def test_fraction_on_years(self):
        """Fractions not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5Y")

    def test_fraction_on_months(self):
        """Fractions not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5M")

    def test_fraction_not_last_component(self):
        """Only the last component may have a fractional part."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5D2H")

    def test_incomplete_fraction_no_digit_after_separator(self):
        """Fractions require at least one digit on each side."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1.S")

    def test_incomplete_fraction_no_digit_before_separator(self):
        """Fractions require at least one digit on each side."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT.5S")

    def test_invalid_separator_in_fraction(self):
        """Only . or , allowed as decimal separator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1-5S")

    def test_multiple_separators_in_fraction(self):
        """Only one decimal point/comma in a component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "PT1.5.5S")

    def test_invalid_character(self):
        """Invalid characters should raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1X")

    def test_empty_string(self):
        """Empty string is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "")

    def test_sign_in_middle(self):
        """Sign must be at the start."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1-D")

    def test_multiple_signs(self):
        """Only one sign allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "+-P1D")


class TestBasicPositiveDurations:
    """Test applying positive durations."""

    def test_years_only(self):
        """P1Y: add one year."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P1Y") == datetime(2026, 3, 15)

    def test_multiple_years(self):
        """P5Y: add five years."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 1), "P5Y") == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_months_only(self):
        """P2M: add two months."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P2M") == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_multiple_months_overflow_year(self):
        """P13M: add 13 months, crossing year boundary."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P13M") == datetime(2026, 2, 15)

    def test_weeks_only(self):
        """P2W: add two weeks (14 days)."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P2W") == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_days_only(self):
        """P10D: add ten days."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P10D") == datetime(2025, 3, 20)

    def test_hours_only(self):
        """PT5H: add five hours."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0), "PT5H") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 15, 0)

    def test_minutes_only(self):
        """PT30M: add thirty minutes."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0), "PT30M") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 30)

    def test_seconds_only(self):
        """PT45S: add forty-five seconds."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0, 0), "PT45S") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0, 45)

    def test_all_components(self):
        """P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S: all components combined."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6)

    def test_years_and_months_together(self):
        """P1Y1M: years and months are applied together as calendar months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros in components are allowed."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P01Y") == datetime(2026, 1, 1)

    def test_plus_sign(self):
        """+P1D: plus sign changes nothing."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "+P1D") == datetime(2025, 1, 2)


class TestNegativeDurations:
    """Test applying negative durations."""

    def test_negative_days(self):
        """-P1D: subtract one day."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "-P1D") == datetime(2025, 3, 9)

    def test_negative_months(self):
        """-P1M: subtract one month."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "-P1M") == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_negative_years(self):
        """-P1Y: subtract one year."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "-P1Y") == datetime(2024, 3, 15)

    def test_negative_months_cross_year(self):
        """-P13M: subtract 13 months across year boundary."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 15), "-P13M") == datetime(2024, 1, 15)

    def test_negative_time_components(self):
        """-PT1H30M: subtract 1 hour 30 minutes."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0), "-PT1H30M") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 8, 30)

    def test_negative_months_and_days(self):
        """-P1M1D: subtract month then day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_negative_all_components(self):
        """-P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S: all components negative."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2026, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6), "-P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)


class TestMonthEndHandling:
    """Test special handling of month-end dates."""

    def test_jan_31_plus_month(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1M = Feb 28/29 (last day of target month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_jan_31_plus_month_leap_year(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1M in leap year = Feb 29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_jan_31_plus_13_months(self):
        """Jan 31 2025 + 13M = Feb 28/29 2026 (last day of target month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P13M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 28)

    def test_jan_31_minus_month(self):
        """Jan 31 - 1M = Dec 31 (last day of target month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 31)

    def test_march_31_plus_month(self):
        """Mar 31 + 1M = Apr 30 (last day of target month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 4, 30)

    def test_multiple_months_to_february(self):
        """Jul 31 + 7M = Feb 28/29 (last day of target month)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 7, 31), "P7M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 28)

    def test_may_31_plus_multiple_months_to_feb(self):
        """May 31 2024 + 9M = Feb 29 2025 (leap year, last day)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 5, 31), "P9M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_dec_31_plus_two_months(self):
        """Dec 31 + 2M = Feb 28/29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 31), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 28)


class TestFractionalDurations:
    """Test fractional components in durations."""

    def test_half_day(self):
        """P0.5D: 0.5 days = 12 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_half_week(self):
        """P0.5W: 0.5 weeks = 3.5 days = 3 days 12 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_half_hour(self):
        """PT0.5H: 0.5 hours = 30 minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30, 0)

    def test_half_minute(self):
        """PT0.5M: 0.5 minutes = 30 seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30)

    def test_fractional_seconds(self):
        """PT1.5S: 1.5 seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fraction_with_comma_separator(self):
        """PT1,5S: comma as decimal separator is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1,5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_day_with_time(self):
        """P1.25D: 1.25 days = 1 day + 6 hours, combined with other components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0), "P1.25D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 16, 0, 0)

    def test_negative_fractional_duration(self):
        """-P0.5D: negative fractional day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 2, 12, 0, 0), "-P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_seconds_with_microseconds(self):
        """PT1.123456S: 1.123456 seconds with microsecond precision."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.123456S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 123456)

    def test_fractional_rounding_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractions are rounded to nearest microsecond."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000001S")
        # 0.0000001 seconds = 0.1 microseconds, rounds to 0
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_rounding_half_microsecond(self):
        """0.5 microseconds rounds to nearest (banker's rounding)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000005S")
        # 0.0000005 seconds = 0.5 microseconds, should round to nearest
        # This tests the rounding behavior
        assert isinstance(result, datetime)


class TestLeapYearHandling:
    """Test leap year calculations."""

    def test_leap_year_february(self):
        """2024 is a leap year, February has 29 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 1), "P27D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_non_leap_year_february(self):
        """2025 is not a leap year, February has 28 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 1), "P27D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 1)

    def test_leap_year_month_boundary(self):
        """Jan 31 + 1M in leap year = Feb 29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_leap_year_century_not_divisible_400(self):
        """1900 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not 400)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(1899, 2, 1), "P365D")
        # 1899 is not a leap year, so Feb has 28 days
        assert result == datetime(1900, 2, 1)


class TestTimeOverflow:
    """Test time component overflow (seconds to minutes, etc.)."""

    def test_seconds_overflow_to_minutes(self):
        """60 seconds = 1 minute."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT60S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0)

    def test_minutes_overflow_to_hours(self):
        """60 minutes = 1 hour."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT60M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0)

    def test_hours_overflow_to_days(self):
        """24 hours = 1 day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT24H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_days_overflow_across_month(self):
        """Days overflow across month boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 30), "P2D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 1)

    def test_days_overflow_across_year(self):
        """Days overflow across year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 31), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 1)


class TestMicrosecondPrecision:
    """Test microsecond precision in time calculations."""

    def test_preserve_microseconds(self):
        """Existing microseconds are preserved when adding integer seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional seconds are converted to microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_fractional_minutes_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional minutes are converted to microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001M")
        # 0.000001 minutes = 0.00006 seconds = 60 microseconds
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 60)

    def test_fractional_hours_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional hours are converted to microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.00001H")
        # 0.00001 hours = 0.036 seconds = 36000 microseconds
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 36000)


class TestComplexScenarios:
    """Test complex multi-component scenarios."""

    def test_years_months_days_time(self):
        """Combined years, months, days, and time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 15, 10, 30, 45), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 18, 14, 35, 51)

    def test_negative_months_then_days(self):
        """Negative months applied before negative days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_month_end_with_subsequent_days(self):
        """Month-end handling followed by day addition."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M5D")
        # Jan 31 + 1M = Feb 28, then + 5D = Mar 5
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 5)

    def test_multiple_fractional_conversions(self):
        """Fractional conversion across multiple units."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P0.5DT0.5H")
        # 0.5D = 12 hours, 0.5H = 30 minutes, total 12.5 hours
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 30, 0)

    def test_zero_weeks(self):
        """P0W: zero weeks should not change the date."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P0W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_zero_days(self):
        """P0D: zero days should not change the date."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P0D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15)

    def test_zero_time(self):
        """PT0H: zero hours should not change the time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 30), "PT0H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 30)


class TestDatetimeRangeErrors:
    """Test that operations outside datetime range raise ValueError."""

    def test_exceeds_max_datetime(self):
        """Adding duration that exceeds maximum datetime raises ValueError."""
        max_dt = datetime(9999, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59, 999999)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(max_dt, "P1D")

    def test_exceeds_min_datetime(self):
        """Subtracting duration below minimum datetime raises ValueError."""
        min_dt = datetime(1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(min_dt, "-P1D")

    def test_large_duration_exceeds_range(self):
        """Very large duration that exceeds range raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(9999, 1, 1), "P1000Y")

    def test_large_negative_duration_exceeds_range(self):
        """Very large negative duration that exceeds range raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 1), "-P1000Y")


class TestEdgeCasesAndPrecision:
    """Test edge cases and precision handling."""

    def test_midnight(self):
        """Operations at midnight."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_end_of_day(self):
        """Operations at end of day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23, 59, 59), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_month_with_30_days(self):
        """Month with 30 days (April, June, Sept, Nov)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 4, 30), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 5, 30)

    def test_month_with_31_days(self):
        """Month with 31 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 31)

    def test_very_small_fractional_duration(self):
        """Very small fractional duration with rounding."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.000001S")
        # 0.000001 seconds = 1 microsecond
        assert result.microsecond == 1

    def test_max_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Maximum fractional seconds that fit in datetime."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "PT59.999999S")
        # 59.999999 seconds
        assert result.second == 59
        assert result.microsecond == 999999

    def test_zero_months(self):
        """P0M: zero months should not change the date."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P0M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_zero_years(self):
        """P0Y: zero years should not change the date."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P0Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)


class TestComponentOrdering:
    """Test that components are applied in the correct order."""

    def test_months_then_days(self):
        """Months applied before days (calendar months, then days)."""
        # Jan 31 + 1M = Feb 28, then + 1D = Mar 1
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 1)

    def test_years_then_months_then_days(self):
        """Years and months applied together, then days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M1D")
        # 1Y1M = 13 months total, Jan 31 + 13M = Feb 28 2025, then + 1D = Mar 1
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 1)

    def test_days_then_time(self):
        """Days applied before time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P1DT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 0, 0)
